tables.name: Barbican
tables.description: A forward structure leading up to the main gate (in a concentric castle, the entry through the outer wall). Modifies Moat. A barbican or outer wall has its own gatehouse.

results.name: Walled Approach
results.description: The gatehouse leads to a walled approach.

results.name: Walled Approach and Drawbridge
results.description: The gatehouse leads to a walled approach, ending in a drawbridge. (+2 to moat roll)

results.name: Two Drawbridges
results.description: The gatehouse, preceded by a drawbridge, leads to a walled approach, ending in an additional drawbridge. (+2 to moat roll)
